def main():
    sc = sys.stdin
    w = int(sc.readline().strip())
    m = int(sc.readline().strip())
    if w < 4:
        print("YES")
        return
    while m > 0:
        remainder = m % w
        next_val = m + 1
        if remainder > 1 and remainder != w - 1:
            print("NO")
            return
        m = next_val // w
    print("YES")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
